'''Ubik's Cube''' is a {{Legendary}} item.

== Obtaining ==
'''Ubik's Cube''' can be obtained from {{NPCSprite|Ubik Von Neumann}} in {{Zone|The Mountaintop}} after completing the [[Ubik Von Neumann#Tit For Tat|Split or Steal]] minigame.

== Usage ==
'''Ubik's Cube''' can be used to play a round of [[Ubik Von Neumann#Tit For Tat|Split or Steal]] with any player or NPC. This has a cooldown of {{Green|2hr}}. Attempting to play a round of Split or Steal will display the following text:
{{Dialogue|&b&lSPLIT! &cYou need to wait [time] before you can play again.}}

It also has a left-click ability, which allows players to view the [[Ubik Von Neumann#Tit For Tat|Split or Steal]] stats of any player or NPC.

== Trivia ==
* '''Ubik's Cube''' is a reference to the toy that the item is modeled after, the ''Rubik's Cube''.
*The '''Split or Steal''' game is based on the [[w:Prisoner's Dilemma|Prisoner's Dilemma]].
